remarks: Meticulously maintained and beautifully updated combined with a super convenient location makes this large 2 bedroom, 2 1/2 bath townhouse with a finished lower level and one car garage highly desirable. Updates too numerous to list, but they include a complete renovation of the primary and guest bathrooms, 1st level 1/2 bath as well as the kitchen. New carpeting throughout and new tile floors in the foyer, kitchen and dining room. New sliders in the living room go out to a covered deck and there is an additional balcony off of each bedroom. Steps away is the heated saltwater pool with ample lounging space for you and your guests to enjoy all summer long. Please note that one resident must be at least 62.
